Author: Mayo Botic
Name: PF Presets
Description: Save and manage Party Finder recruitment presets. Configure duty, objective, roles, conditions, and more - then apply any preset with a single click to instantly set up your Party Finder listing.
Punchline: One-click Party Finder presets. Save your recruitment settings and reuse them instantly.
Changelog: Added a confirmation prompt before deleting a preset. Fixed a rare crash when the plugin was unloaded mid-apply, and made duty selection safer so a renamed high-end duty can't post the wrong listing. Removed two options that never actually did anything (Unselect Classes and 'or Above'). Plus a large internal code cleanup.
